from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        stage1 = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.CAESAR_WORKER_DIRECT,
                prompt_custom.CAESAR_WORKER_CHECKLIST,
                prompt_custom.CAESAR_WORKER_WRAP,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAESAR_AGGREGATE_CANDIDATES,
        )
        draft = await stage1(problem)

        stage2 = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=2,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.CAESAR_CONSENSUS_WORKER,
                prompt_custom.CAESAR_CONSENSUS_WORKER,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAESAR_FINAL_AGGREGATOR,
        )
        solution = await stage2(draft["response"])

        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

{problem}

{problem}
